title: Assignment 07 · Offer and acceptance
summary: Offer and acceptance. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Lefkowitz v. Great Minneapolis Surplus Store: A definite advertisement identifying the item, price, time, and first person entitled to buy could be accepted by the requested conduct; an unannounced restriction could not then be added.

Wucherpfennig v. Dooley: A statement of readiness to proceed, coupled with unresolved questions about the price, did not unequivocally accept the land-sale offer.

International Filter Co. v. Conroe Gin, Ice & Light Co.: The purchaser’s order specified executive approval as sufficient acceptance. The seller’s approval created the contract without a separate notification requirement.

White v. Corlies & Tifft: Uncommunicated preparations using materials equally suitable for other jobs did not accept an offer inviting an agreement to complete the work.
